description: This file contains serialization utility functions for string conversions, encoding/decoding (hex, Base64), and Unicode (UTF-16, code points) handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It implements functions for converting between narrow and wide strings, hex and Base64 string encoding/decoding, as well as UTF-16 encoding/decoding operations.

methods.description: Converts a wide-character string to a standard string, considering platform-specific conversions.

methods.description: Converts a narrow-character string to a wide string.
